companyDescription: Commercial + defense launch + lunar services · Alpha Block 2 / VICTUS HAZE Sep 30 · Blue Ghost Mission 2 late 2026 · SciTec Golden Dome SHIELD IDIQ
priceNote: NASA $144M CLPS contract (Jul 2) for 2028 Blue Ghost lunar mission — stock +1% on deal. Q2 earnings est. Aug 4; trades at ~14x FY26E revenue vs RKLB ~70x.
summary: Firefly Aerospace secured a $144M NASA CLPS contract (Jul 2, 2026) for a rapid Blue Ghost lunar mission targeted for 2028 — validating the standardized lander platform after Mission 1 success. Q1 revenue was a record $80.9M (+40% QoQ) with FY2026 guidance $420-450M. The stock trades at ~$29 with analyst avg PT $48 (+68%). Q2 earnings (~Aug 4) is the next financial catalyst; Alpha Block 2 VICTUS HAZE launch Sep 30 remains the binary mission catalyst.

risks: Alpha Block 2 first-flight binary — VICTUS HAZE Sep 30 is a new rocket iteration; failure = 1-year setback + program reset
SpaceX IPO contagion — if SpaceX goes public, institutional capital rotates OUT of RKLB/FLY and INTO SpaceX directly
Cash burn pre-FCF positive — $420-450M FY guidance requires execution on schedule; delays = cash crunch
Q2 delivery vs Q1 momentum — Q1 +45% YoY sets a high bar; Q2 must show sequential progression
RKLB competitive overlap — Rocket Lab competes for same responsive launch + defense contracts
Management team relatively new — Abu Dhabi capital + IPO team still building institutional relationships

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed at 3.50–3.75%; defense and government space contracts are rate-insensitive. FLY revenue is NASA CLPS + DoD contracts — decoupled from consumer rate sensitivity.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE 3.4%; launch costs (propellant, components) are inflation-exposed but DoD contracts include inflation adjustments. Iran oil risk = higher fuel costs but manageable.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Golden Dome + NATO + DARPA responsive launch spending = secular tailwind. Defense space spending is rising globally. Q2 earnings in 9 days = near-term trump card.
macroRisk.summary: LOW — government/defense contract base insulates from rate/inflation. Primary risk is launch execution (Block 2) and SpaceX IPO contagion.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Commercial launch companies typically rally 10-20% in the 2-3 weeks before a mission launch, especially for defense/DoD missions. Firefly has Needham conference Jul 9 + Q2 earnings Jul 10 as dual near-term catalysts creating a pre-run window NOW.

postWin.note: Blue Ghost Mission 1 success (Mar 22, 2026) — first commercial lunar landing — drove +24% in 3 days. VICTUS HAZE would validate Block 2 reliability + responsive launch cadence for DoD, comparable to a major delivery beat in space launch sector.

postLose.note: Alpha Vehicle 2 (Oct 2022 partial failure) sent stock -25% and delayed program 18 months. Block 2 failure in Sep 2026 would be similar magnitude selloff.

spotSizing.reason: Q2 earnings in 9 days is the immediate catalyst; 14x EV/Sales vs RKLB 70x = relative value. Moderate speculative sizing 4-6%; increase after Q2 beat confirmation.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Below Apr support = Q2 miss or VICTUS HAZE delay signal

stopPostCatalyst.note: If VICTUS HAZE Block 2 fails Sep 30, exit; launch execution is the entire thesis

comparableCases.event: Blue Ghost Mission 1 — First Commercial Lunar Landing
comparableCases.note: Blue Ghost Mission 1 successfully landed on the Moon on March 22, 2026 — first-ever commercial lunar landing. Stock +24% in 3 days. Sets the template for Blue Ghost Mission 2 and validates Firefly's technical capability.

comparableCases.event: Rocket Lab Photon satellite bus validation — DoD contract ramp
comparableCases.note: RKLB's successful DoD missions and satellite bus validation drove re-rating from pure-play launch to multi-domain space infrastructure. FLY is on a similar trajectory — Blue Ghost (lunar) + VICTUS HAZE (DoD) = multi-domain validation.
